verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਚਸਾ ਘੜੀ ਪਹਰੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਥਿਤਿ ਸੁ ਵਾਰ ਸਭਾਗੇ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)n pal chasaa ghaRee pahar dha(n)n dha(n)n thit su vaar sabhaage|

en.bdb: Blessed is the moment, the blinking time, the hour, the date, the day (during which you remember the Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਦਿਹੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਪਖੁ ਮਾਹ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੰਮਤਿ ਜਾਗੇ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)n dha(n)n dhih raat hai pakh maeh rut sa(n)mat jaage|

en.bdb: Day, night, fortnight, months, season and the year are auspicious wherein mind tries to rise (to divinity).

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਅਭੀਚੁ ਨਿਛਤੁ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਹੈ ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਤਿਆਗੇ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)n abheech nichhaturr hai kaam krodh aha(n)kaar tiaage|

en.bdb: That is the most auspicious time (abheech nachitr is an astrological term) when one repudiates lust, anger, and ego.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਹੈ ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਰਾਜ ਪਿਰਾਗੇ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)n dha(n)n sa(n)jog hai aThasaTh teerath raaj piraage|

en.bdb: That time is fortunate wherein (through meditation on God) one gets the fruits of the holy dip at the sixty eight pilgrim centers and the Prayagraj.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਆਇ ਕੈ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਗੇ।
verses.translit_en: guroo dhuaarai aai kai charan kaval ras a(n)mrit paage|

en.bdb: Reaching the door of Guru (the Gurudwara) mind gets absorbed in the delight of the lotus feet (of Guru).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਅਵੇਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਅਨਭੈ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਰੀ ਅਨੁਰਾਗੇ।
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes aves kar anabhai piram piree anuraage|

en.bdb: Adopting the teachings of Guru, the state of fearlessness and total absorption in the love (of Lord) is attained.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਅੰਗਿ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਗੇ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv saadhasa(n)g a(n)g a(n)g ik ra(n)g samaage|

en.bdb: Immersing the consciousness in the shabad (word) through and in the holy congregation, every limb (of the devotee) reverberates the lustre of the (steadfast) colour of the Lord.
The Sikhs of the Guru have made jewel garland of the fragile thread of breath (and they make full use of the same).
